items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I went with Raeburn later... just played two or three jobs with him.

ctx.x: I did. I had my own band. He's right. I did have my own band. I went with Raeburn later, and I didn't -- I wasn't with Raeburn over about four months, three or four months, not long, just played two or three jobs with him. But I had my own band going for quite a while after I left -- after I left Barnet.
Whom did you have in your band?
